subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He asked me __what is my name__?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option(3) i.e. "what my name was."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect speech** requires backshifting of tenses, so **"is" **should become **"was" **after** "asked,"** a past tense verb.
 
• Therefore, **"what my name was"** properly backshifts the tense and fits the indirect speech rule.
 
• The structure **"what my name was" **correctly omits the question format used in direct speech, aligning with the guidelines for **converting questions into indirect speech.**

**Therefore, the correct sentence is- "He asked me what my name was.__"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ("what is my name.") retains the direct question format and present tense, which is inappropriate for indirect speech in this context.
 
• Option 2 ("what my name has been.") implies a duration or change over time, which is irrelevant to the context of asking someone's name.
 
• Option 4 ("what was my name?") incorrectly retains question punctuation and reverses the word order, not aligning with the conventions of indirect speech.
